g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-406 Metal detector conveyor (built frame, used head) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN (CCP-1: record results in the CCP log)
Material certs 304 (EN 10204 3.1); UHMW and belt FDA letters; FRP datasheet (non-conductive)
Used head: maker's service report, serial, aperture and lug drawing; head stand re-dimensioned if needed
Pulley axes parallel and square to the flow; belt top level both ends
No metal inside |x| < 475 (static) and < 600 (moving): screws nylon, rails FRP, no guides
Belt tracking at speed for 10 min, splice flat
Pack clearance in the aperture, S and J (gauge pack of each)
Head isolated from the frame on the +y lug (G10 + bushes): no conductive loop through the stand
Head sensitivity set up by the service engineer with the product (packs of each spice), phase / gain locked
Pusher: retracted clear of the J guide line; extended pack lands in the bin, both packs, 20 cycles
Bin locked: lid open (B3) stops the line; key held by QA only
Run-time check reminder (amber every 4 h) and START acknowledge
Wiring vs E01; PE continuity stud → frame, motor, head stand side
Hi-pot / insulation, cord to PE (G1 disconnected)
Test piece Fe 1.5 on the leading, middle and trailing edge of a jar, aperture centre: rejected + B2 confirm
Fail-safe: head unplugged, W5 cut, bin full (B2 blocked), lid open, E-stop: each stops the belt, red / amber
False rejects: 200 clean packs of each product
Rate 14 packs / min for 10 min without a stop
Belt tracking, splice, bed wear; bearings grease H1
Head validation by the service engineer
Pack pitch at the line rate
14 packs / min; packs are well spaced for one-at-a-time reject
head length + jar Ø, well above the head's minimum (≈ 0.1 s)
620 mm at 267 mm/s; B1 window ±0.5 s
packs + belt on UHMW (μ 0.3) + pulley drag
with start factor 1.5; gearmotor 8.5 N·m: SF 14
3 packs + bed + belt on a 970 span, E 17 GPa
1.5 / 2.0 x aperture height 250 each side of the head faces
fuse 6 A T; 24 V 3.2 A supply
1. This conveyor carries CCP-1 (metal) in the HACCP plan. A pack may only leave the conveyor at the outfeed end after passing a healthy head, or into the locked bin.
2. Before production each day and every 4 h: T15-T17 with the certified test pieces (kept by QA). A failed test: hold all packs since the last good test and re-run them.
3. Rejects: QA opens the bin, logs each pack, re-runs it once; a second reject is investigated (the source of the metal is found before the line restarts).
4. Any change to the head settings, the belt speed or the reject timing needs T9 and T15-T18 again.
